policies.title: SCENTAI MVP commerce status
policies.content: SCENTAI currently provides fragrance discovery, comparison, and reference market pricing. SCENTAI does not currently operate its own checkout, shipping, returns, warranties, memberships, gift cards, or price-match services. If a customer asks about these services, state that they are not yet available directly through SCENTAI. Do not invent retailer policies.

policies.title: Reference market pricing
policies.content: Prices shown by SCENTAI are reference market prices based on validated pricing data available at the recorded price-check date. Fragrance prices can change and the displayed value is not a guaranteed checkout price. When available, use price_checked_at and market_price_eur from the product data.

policies.title: Community fragrance ratings
policies.content: Customer-facing fragrance ratings should use community_rating_10 and rating_source when available. Rating count and evidence confidence should also be considered. A higher average rating based on a small sample does not automatically make a fragrance the better recommendation.

policies.title: Fragrance relationship classifications
policies.content: SCENTAI uses catalog relationship data to distinguish benchmark, clone, inspired, and alternative fragrances. These classifications support recommendations but must not be converted into invented similarity percentages or unsupported claims of exact duplication.
